meta.title: Subagent models
meta.description: Choose subagent provider groups, models and reasoning efforts, with custom Chat, Responses and Claude APIs.

ui.title: Subagent models
ui.subtitle: Give subtasks their own model while keeping your main conversation unchanged.
ui.scope: Applies across this profile, only when a local subagent is created. Existing or resumed children, the main agent, and external Codex / Claude Code processes are unchanged.
ui.inheritHelp: Do not override the child model. Usually inherits the parent; existing tool defaults are preserved.
ui.fixedHelp: Choose a fixed provider, model and effort for new local children, including spawn, fork and local teammates.
ui.noEffort: This model advertises no reasoning efforts. Auto does not inherit another model’s effort.
ui.saved: Saved. The next new local subagent will use this setting.
ui.partialCatalog: Some provider groups could not be loaded. Available groups can still be selected.
ui.missingModel: The saved model is unavailable. Select another model.
ui.customHelp: Create a separate DSH model group. After adding it, choose an effort and save the model selection. Existing groups are untouched. Edit the group later under DSH Settings → Models.
ui.slugHelp: 1–40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. The dsh-subagent- prefix is added automatically.
ui.urlHelp: For example https://api.example.com/v1. A pasted chat/completions, responses or messages suffix is removed; the DSH adapter appends its endpoint.
ui.modelHelp: Use the exact identifier accepted by the API, not its display label.
ui.keyHelp: Submitted only to the DSH credential service, never stored in plugin config, source, browser storage or tool arguments.
ui.capabilities: Reasoning efforts supported by this API (optional)
ui.capabilitiesHelp: Select only values your provider actually supports. None means no effort is sent. This does not probe API capabilities.
ui.apiAdded: API group added and placed in the model selection draft. Choose an effort and click Save settings.
ui.keySavedPartial: The key was saved under the reference below, but the provider could not be saved. Check DSH model settings before retrying. The saved key will not be deleted automatically.
ui.providerSavedPartial: The group was saved, but activation verification or reading the latest state failed. Reload and check DSH model settings; do not add it again.
ui.security: Custom APIs receive subtask content and tool results; forked children also send inherited conversation history. Use only trusted providers. HTTP is unencrypted.
ui.policy: Does not change DSH model-selection authorization. Omit model arguments when delegating; explicit unauthorized choices are still rejected by DSH. Changing a fork’s model may reduce cache reuse.
ui.apiUnavailable: The built-in custom API adapter is unavailable. Existing models remain selectable.
ui.error.select_model: Choose a provider and model, or enter a valid model ID.
ui.error.model_unavailable: The model is unavailable. Reload the catalog.
ui.error.effort_unavailable: The model does not support this effort.
ui.error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) API URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
ui.error.invalid_slug: Use 1–40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
ui.error.invalid_credential_ref: Use a valid environment-variable-style credential reference.
ui.error.invalid_token_limits: Token limits must be positive integers; maximum output cannot exceed the context window.
ui.error.invalid_efforts: Include at least one actual reasoning effort; off alone is not supported.
ui.error.provider_activation_failed: The group was saved but its adapter did not activate. Check DSH model settings and reload.
ui.error.plugin_settings_unavailable: Plugin settings are not available. Refresh the page or check plugin activation.
ui.error.api_adapter_unavailable: A compatible DSH custom API adapter was not found.
ui.error.settings_conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving; your draft did not overwrite them.
ui.error.provider_exists: This group identifier already exists. Choose another identifier or edit it in DSH model settings.
ui.error.credential_missing: No credential is configured. Save an API key first.
